in_sanskrit.name: कृतिका
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Kirtika is derived from the Sanskrit word 'kritika', which means 'star' or 'constellation'. It is believed that Kirtika represents the constellation Pleiades and is associated with the god Indra. In Hindu astrology, Kirtika is considered an auspicious star and is believed to bring good fortune and success.

in_hindi.name: कृतिका
in_hindi.long_meaning: In Hindi, the name Kirtika is pronounced as 'Kṛtikā' and also as 'Kūḍdī'. The meaning of the name remains the same as in Sanskrit, i.e., 'star' or 'constellation'. It is a popular name among Hindus and is believed to bring good luck and success.

in_tamil.name: கிர்திகா
in_tamil.long_meaning: In Tamil, the name Kirtika is pronounced as 'Kirtikā' and is written as 'கிர்திகா'. The meaning of the name is 'star' or 'constellation'. In Tamil culture, stars and constellations are considered auspicious and are believed to have a significant influence on one's life. The name Kirtika is believed to bring good fortune and success.

in_telugu.name: కృతికా
